title: Straight-Line Graphs: y = mx + c
summary: Tables, graphs and equations for linear relationships: gradient and intercept in real situations.

ib.note: Linear functions are MYP 3 (extended in MYP 4–5)

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 13: Introduction to Graphs

objectives: I can make a table of values and plot a straight-line graph.
I can explain what m and c mean in a real situation.
I can use a graph to make predictions.
misconceptions: All graphs start at the origin.
A bigger c makes a line steeper.
A negative gradient means the y-values are negative.
